Shadow of the Road - Official Anime Opening Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
Shadow of the Road is a tactical RPG set in an alternative version of 19th-century Japan. The new trailer reimagines the game as a shounen anime, complete with an epic soundtrack. The "anime opening" features the song METAHOPE by Japanese hypermetal band Earthists and depicts the main characters and their friendship, effort, and victory in their struggle against the forces of the Emperor.

text:
Up Close with the Avengers: Doomsday Costumes | NYCC 2026
Doomsday is coming! With the release of Avengers: Doomsday getting ever closer, we got to take a closer look at the Costumes from the upcoming film, from the floor of NYCC 2026! With the costumes for Red Guardian and Bob / Sentry of the New Avengers (or New AvengerZ if you prefer.. Or Thunderbolts), as well as the new X-Men costumes for Nightcrawler, Mystique, and Gambit! We also got to see Sue Storm’s Fantastic Four outfit, Shuri’s Black Panther outfit, and of course Sam’s Captain America uniform! 

We also got to see the threads of the main man himself, the man of the hour, Victor Von Doom, better known as Doctor Doom. What secrets did we find hiding in these outfits? Check out the video and find out!
 
Avengers Doomsday releases in cinemas on December 18th!

text:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Official 'Burn The Sky' Music Video | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
Check out the music video for "Burn The Sky," by Casey Edwards & Ollie Swift, a new music track from the Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen expansion for the action RPG! 

In Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, the fantasy world has been expanded with new tales and encounters. Embark to a snowy new area in the north: the long-abandoned Norgan region, and take on 12 new dungeon challenges spread across the existing world of Dragon's Dogma 2. Bring your Arisen and Pawns to life with new hairstyles and tattoo options. 

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen arrives on Nintendo Switch 2, containing both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content in one package. The Dark Arisen Expansion will be available as a separate DLC on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC. Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.
